semantics.source: Feature-tile-major Matrix writeback resident in Vector SRAM
semantics.destination: A 16-bank Matrix-SRAM projection region indexed by physical row and bank
semantics.scatter_on_write: The architectural instruction materializes the producer-consumer layout before X_STATE may consume it
semantics.row_major: source index i maps to row=floor(i/banks), bank=i mod banks
semantics.transpose: logical [row,column] maps through column-major linearization before bank selection
semantics.skewed: field-local coordinates map to a physical row and a cyclic bank rotation
semantics.activation_policy: v1 accepts FP32, BF16, or FP16 Vector SRAM; MX8 activation is rejected until scale-aware Vector SRAM exists
